answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the comet seed, the inlet timing is verifiable from the opal record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 334 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 98 keys as a result pays 98 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
